label: Bible Study
prompt: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a _____ received him out of their sight.
verse: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
note: The ascension — Jesus taken up while they watched, and a cloud closed the view.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which _____ me all my life long unto this day,
verse: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
note: Old Jacob blesses Joseph, calling God the one who fed him all his life long.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe _____, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
verse: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
note: Nathan's parable of the poor man's one little ewe lamb — the story that trapped a king into judging himself.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to _____ life.
verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
note: Joseph, revealing himself to the brothers who sold him, reframes the whole betrayal as God's rescue plan.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is like the precious _____ upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verse: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
note: Unity is like anointing oil on Aaron's head, running down his beard to his robe — fragrant, generous, holy.
